notes: Outbound scaffolding manifest. Operation classes are the only retail_class_name-annotated outbound classes in opcodes.json; the gap is 55 serverbound opcodes with no class annotation - filling those requires a Ghidra opcode-emission scan or class-driven decomp. Aux enrichments come from manifests/operation_opcode_map_overlay.json: per-class vtable/confirmedEmissions/confirmedReceives blocks, per-opcode gap extras, top-level enrichment sections, and notes appendices. | lua-name-to-opcode-bridge-open update: added candidateEmitters per serverbound opcode from a binary-wide MOV-write-imm scan. Hit counts and distinct-function counts indicate confidence; opcodes with low counts that hit Operation/Builder-named functions are the highest-confidence emitters.

classDrivenScan.method: class-driven: (1) enumerate Operation vtable slots via .rdata dword sweep + Ghidra symbol resolution; (2) decompile each slot 0 (SendRequest); (3) FindAllReferences on the canonical packet allocator FUN_00DA2BE0; (4) read the opcode arg passed at each call site via PUSH-imm heuristic in the 64 bytes preceding the CALL instruction.

packetAllocator.signature: (this, opcode, size, flag); stores opcode at this[7]
packetAllocator.callerSummary: 4 are Operation::vtable[0] SendRequest methods; 1 is the auxiliary FrontendAuth emitter FUN_004E2850 (BCS-Y-0297)

auxiliaryEmitters.note: Parallel auth-token refresh path; emits the same 0x1F5/0x1F6 pair as LobbyLoginOperation::SendRequest. The 0x1F6 branch additionally calls FUN_00447260 (Lua dispatcher) with a format-string global, suggesting Lua-event notification on the rebind path.

classDrivenScan.architecturalFinding: All 4 LobbyClient::*Operation vftables share an identical 5-slot shape: [0] SendRequest (unique per class, the opcode emitter), [1] ReceiveDispatcher (unique per class, dispatches on inbound header opcode), [2] AckResponse (shared FUN_00DAD7B0 = BCS-Y-0113), [3] Stub (shared FUN_00DAD8E0 = BCS-Y-0114, returns 0), [4] scalar deleting destructor (unique per class). Sibling subclasses of a common base (LobbyOperation, vftable 0x01128A60); overrides only at slots 0/1/4.
classDrivenScan.scopeBoundary: The remaining 39-opcode serverbound gap (MapServerbound / WorldServerbound buckets 0x0001..0x01DD) is emitted from classes OUTSIDE the LobbyClient::*Operation family (Network::MapChannel / Network::WorldChannel + their builders) which lack retail_class_name annotations in opcodes.json. The lua-name-to-opcode-bridge-open pass (if scoped) would extend the same methodology to those channel classes.
